item.title: [Panic Fest Review] BLACK MOLD is a Study of Fear and the Decaying Mind
item.description: Like a decaying body in a rural field, the abandoned buildings scattered across the country decay, rot, and decompose, eaten away by bacteria and fungi. In his dramatic horror thriller Black Mold, writer and director John Pata employs this setting to explore trauma and fear.
